description: Hi, I'm Dayana, my husband, our two sons, & I proudly call Sykesville/Eldersburg our forever home - because from the moment we arrived, we truly felt right at home. I'm running for Maryland House of Delegates - District 5 to help service Carroll County & Southeastern Frederick County. I'm here to listen, I understand how to find solutions & represent district 5 as a whole. I'm here to move District 5 forward & uplift others to join our team, be part of the work, to help one another.
title: Dayana Bergman | Maryland House of Delegate District 5
